_meta.project: instex Instrument Explorer -- TELESCOPES mode: Hobby-Eberly Telescope (HET) after the Wide Field Upgrade -- prime focus and the moving entrance pupil
_meta.companion: data/telescopes/het.md (same content as Markdown). Structure follows keck.json / magellan.json for a single telescope: sources{key: cite, file, url}; het: title, telescope (machine-readable primary, pupil, foci list; refs point to sourced params as 'het.<param>'), params, not_found, conflicts, notes.
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/telescopes/het/. derived = arithmetic done here (shown). alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts). figure_readoff = a value read off a saved figure (its caption or a nearby text quote is checked). NOT FOUND marks a gap. Nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.quote_normalisation: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, multiplication sign (to x), division slash, tilde operator, middle dot, the degree sign and the white-bullet degree glyph (U+25E6) normalised; whitespace collapsed; a quote also passes against the text with PDF line-end hyphenation removed or closed up, or with all whitespace removed; ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces.
_meta.texts_checked: pdftotext -layout and -raw per page (PDF p. = page index of the saved PDF; for the GMT OAD this equals the printed 'Page N of 262'), tag-stripped text and raw source for HTML (UTF-8), .py and .md as is
_meta.pupil_frame: pyHETobs frame (metres on the primary seen from the sky; x right, y up; segment columns along y)
_meta.design_vs_asbuilt: H21, G21, K21, MDO describe the upgraded HET (2015-); H21 Table 1 gives the original HET for comparison; pyHETobs = third-party pupil model
_meta.check_result: 82 quotes checked against the saved files, 0 failures (2026-10-19)
